about: PeerRoutingRecord v2 (pp-browser SIGNED_FORMATS 2.10, RC020). signed = "pp-mesh:dht-record" 00 || u8 2 || Len("type=peer_routing") || Len(peer_id) || Len("seq="dec) || Len("ttl_seconds="dec) || Len("issued_at="dec) || u32 n || n x Len(multiaddr) || u8 caps_present [|| u8 circuit_relay || u8 media_relay] || ext area (u64 BE length || entries); Len = u32 BE length then UTF-8. JSON: version 2 read first, ext_b64 (absent when empty), typed signature_b64 and public_key_b64 (u8 alg id || body; 1 = ml-dsa-65). Signatures are hedged, frozen whole. result: ok | older | update_needed | malformed | forgery; step: of the receiver's order (1 version, 2 parse, 3 algorithms, 4 signature, 5 extensions).

signed_bytes.name: empty_area
signed_bytes.about: the input with the empty area (every record at release 1)

signed_bytes.name: one_non_critical
signed_bytes.about: the input with one unknown non-critical entry, type 0x0001

records.name: signed
records.about: the input, empty area, signed: verifies

records.name: signed_one_non_critical
records.about: the input with the unknown non-critical entry, signed: verifies, the entry kept (ext_b64 unchanged)

records.name: version_plus_one
records.about: signed's JSON with version 3: update needed, nothing verified

records.name: version_minus_one
records.about: signed's JSON with version 1: made by an older build

records.name: version_missing
records.about: signed's JSON without version: made by an older build (v1 always wrote one)

records.name: unknown_critical
records.about: the input with a critical entry, type 0x8001, signed: verifies, then update needed

records.name: unknown_signature_algorithm
records.about: signed with the signature's id byte 2 (unassigned): update needed

records.name: unknown_key_algorithm
records.about: signed with the key's id byte 2 (unassigned): update needed

records.name: signature_algorithm_zero
records.about: signed with the signature's id byte 0 (invalid): malformed

records.name: ext_unsorted
records.about: signed with an ext_b64 whose entries are not sorted: malformed

records.name: changed_field
records.about: signed with seq 8: the signature does not hold

records.name: wrong_key
records.about: signed with another valid key, one that does not derive peer_id
